legacy.label: legacy stage-2 baseline, the frozen evaluator's own per-regime export

v2_nocomb.label: v2 with the comb muted (floor only)
v2_nocomb.hypothesis: control: what PIT MAE looks like when there is no comb at all

v2_amp_exp0.label: v2 with amp_exp pinned to 0 (comb speed envelope neutral)
v2_amp_exp0.hypothesis: H1: the comb's speed scaling extrapolated from cruise

v2_floor_exp0.label: v2 with floor_exp pinned to 0 and no static pedestal (floor speed envelope neutral)
v2_floor_exp0.hypothesis: H2: the floor's speed envelope extrapolated from cruise

v2_both_exp0.label: v2 with BOTH speed envelopes neutral (amp_exp = floor_exp = 0)

v2_floor_calib.label: floor-only render with floor_exp = 0: the calibration of v2_floor_matched

v2_floor_matched.label: v2 with the floor re-levelled onto THIS support's real broadband level
v2_floor_matched.hypothesis: H2 in its strongest form: the floor level alone

v2_prior_exps.label: v2 with BOTH exponents at their prior means (amp_exp = floor_exp = 2, static_rel at its own prior mean)
v2_prior_exps.hypothesis: the patch: what the fit would render if the unidentified exponents were pinned

v2_level_matched_exps.label: v2 with BOTH exponents at the value the REAL clips' own cruise-to-regime level ratio implies
v2_level_matched_exps.hypothesis: the ceiling of a single global speed envelope: what is left is the comb profile itself

v2_prior_exps_nofloor.label: prior-mean exponents with the floor muted: the fitted comb alone
v2_prior_exps_nofloor.hypothesis: residual: is what is left after the envelopes the FLOOR, or the comb itself?

v2_prior_exps_lowjitter.label: prior-mean exponents with the shaft jitter at a quarter of the fitted sigma_nu
v2_prior_exps_lowjitter.hypothesis: residual: the cruise-fitted shaft jitter is a 2.2x larger FRACTION of a standby carrier
